## ✨ 本次更新
### 🚀 iOS 版本正式来袭
- Clipaste iOS 版已经上架 App Store。 - 它不只是一个剪贴板 App，更是一款可以随时切换出来使用的输入法键盘。 - 在任何可以输入文字的地方，都可以切到 Clipaste，直接取用常用文本、链接和图片。 - 开启 iCloud 同步后，Mac 端的剪贴板历史可以同步到 iOS 键盘里，随时可用。
### 🛠 修复与体验优化
- 修复快捷粘贴只能使用前 9 项的问题。现在滚动到后面的内容时，也可以对当前可见内容使用快捷粘贴。 - 修复盲打搜索无法输入符号的问题。现在 `Shift + 数字` 输入的符号也可以正常触发搜索。
### ☁️ iCloud 同步优化
- 优化 iCloud 同步体验，提升多端数据同步的稳定性与一致性。 - 改进 Mac 与 iOS 之间的同步衔接，让剪贴板历史在多设备间更自然地流转。
---
## ✨ What's New
### 🚀 iOS Version Is Here
- Clipaste for iOS is now available on the App Store. - It is not just a clipboard app. It is a keyboard you can switch to anytime. - Wherever you can type, you can switch to Clipaste and quickly reuse saved text, links, and images. - With iCloud sync enabled, your Mac clipboard history can appear in the iOS keyboard and stay available when you need it.
### 🛠 Fixes & Improvements
- Fixed quick paste only working with the first 9 items. After scrolling, quick paste now works with the currently visible items. - Fixed type-to-search not accepting symbols. Symbols typed with `Shift + number` now correctly activate search.
### ☁️ iCloud Sync Improvements
- Improved iCloud sync stability and consistency across devices. - Refined the connection between Mac and iOS so clipboard history moves more smoothly between them.

### ✨ 本次更新
#### 🍏 核心功能与优化 - iCloud 同步机制重构：深度优化同步底层逻辑，数据同步体验更丝滑、无感。 - 新增后台轮询机制：支持后台自动静默刷新，确保多端数据时刻保持最新。
#### 🔮 精彩预告 - iOS/iPadOS 版本终测启动：iOS/iPad 开发已进入最后冲刺测试！即将实现与 Mac 端的丝滑联动、无缝衔接，敬请期待！

#### 🔮 Coming Soon - iOS/iPad Version Final Testing: The iOS/iPad application has entered its final testing phase! Smooth integration and seamless multi-device linkage with Mac are just around the corner. Stay tuned!
